properties.name: indentation
properties.comment: Width of one tree level, in logical units; the tree column's text starts after the indentation, the expander and the icon.
prepare: throw std::invalid_argument("TreeListView indentation is outside the indentation bounds");

properties.name: image_list
properties.comment: The images that the nodes' image_key values name; a list must be alive and belong to this view's Window.
hand: prepare_write: a live list of the own Window; written: resubscribe to the list changes

properties.name: font
properties.comment: The font of the header, the rows and the cells.
prepare: if (!valid_font_spec(incoming)) throw std::invalid_argument("TreeListView font specification is invalid");

properties.name: selected_id
properties.comment: The selected node's stable ID, or none.
hand: view over selected_node_: write expands ancestors, makes it current and visible, publishes the expansions and the selection
